extraction.method: ffprobe best_effort_timestamp list; seek to the middle of each frame interval; await seeked + requestVideoFrameCallback; detectForVideo(video, round(pts ms), strictly increasing)

truth.visualNote: One recurve shot in a garden range; the archer is small in frame (camera high and far, slightly behind). sources.md: release at about 4.43-4.44 s, bow lowered and archer leaves after 5 s, empty range after 9 s. Frame check for this benchmark (2026-11-14): raising/drawing at 1.5-2.4 s; empty, panning range at 12.9-13.6 s.

columns: tMs, then per point: x, y, z, visibility (normalized like MediaPipe); [tMs] alone = no pose
